items.authors: Hao Zhang, Mingjie Liu, Shaokun Zhang, Songyang Han, Jian Hu, Zhenghui Jin, Yuchi Zhang, Shizhe Diao, Ximing Lu, Binfeng Xu, Zhiding Yu, Jan Kautz, Yi Dong

items.title: EffectErase: Joint Video Object Removal and Insertion for High-Quality Effect Erasing

items.title: VideoAtlas: Navigating Long-Form Video in Logarithmic Compute
items.authors: Mohamed Eltahir, Ali Habibullah, Yazan Alshoibi, Lama Ayash, Tanveer Hussain, Naeemullah Khan

items.title: Online Experiential Learning for Language Models
items.authors: Tianzhu Ye, Li Dong, Qingxiu Dong, Xun Wu, Shaohan Huang, Furu Wei
items.one_sentence_summary: 这篇论文提出了在线经验学习（OEL）框架，使语言模型能够从其部署经验中持续改进，通过提取和积累可转移的经验知识，并通过在线策略上下文蒸馏将其整合到模型参数中。
